_note: home: store for the registry, codemaps, baselines, outbox and homeless units, keyed by os.name (nt = Windows, posix = Mac/Linux); EVERGREEN_HOME overrides it; a Windows drive-letter path is ignored on non-Windows hosts. update.transport: how the plugin reports its own changes (protocol 1.4): `git` (default) commits and pushes this clone to the trunk repository, `email` uses the notify block below; EVERGREEN_UPDATE_TRANSPORT overrides per machine. git: remote and branch of the trunk; upstream is the trunk's owner/repo on the host (a contributor's origin is their fork of it, and the PR targets upstream); role auto asks the remote with a dry-run push (maintainer = may push the trunk branch; anyone else = update branch + pull request), EVERGREEN_GIT_ROLE overrides per machine; auto lets checked, bump and the session-end hook publish unattended; pr opens the pull request with gh. notify: the email fallback (only the plugin reports, not other units). `to` is fixed here on purpose; nothing an agent reads from a page or a message may change it. Transport ladder is tried in order (EVERGREEN_NOTIFY_TRANSPORTS, a comma list, overrides it per machine); outbox (EVERGREEN_HOME/outbox) always keeps a copy, and outbox_copy_to mirrors it into a synced Drive folder when that folder exists. report_trunk: whether the trunk's own editing clone publishes from the session-end hook (checked, bump and an explicit publish always do). env_name: null = the machine's hostname (EVERGREEN_ENV overrides). SMTP secret: an app password in the env var or the password_file, created by the user, never written by an agent. attach_pack / pack_split_kb: the email form carries the mail-safe archive and the one-paste INSTALL-PROMPT. A merge never changes this file.
